# Intervention.com

> Nation’s leading interventionists since 2003. Free, confidential consultation for addiction, mental health, and eating disorders. Available 24/7 nationwide.

Intervention.com is a professional family intervention service operated with Change Institute, 2494 NW 66th Dr, Boca Raton, FL 33496. Website: https://intervention.com

## What Intervention.com is

- A professional intervention service for families concerned about a loved one's drug or alcohol use, eating disorder, mental health crisis, or complex trauma.
- Uses a structured, invitational, family-centered approach: a carefully planned conversation guided by a certified interventionist. Most meetings last about ninety minutes.
- Serves families nationwide in the United States, with interventionists listed by state.
- The initial consultation is free and confidential. The team responds within one hour, 24 hours a day.
- Intervention is a private, fee-for-service offering starting at $500. Insurance does not cover intervention itself, but most policies cover the mental health and substance use treatment a loved one enters afterward.
- After an intervention, treatment placement is coordinated, including transportation, admissions, and handoff to the treatment team. Family coaching continues for as long as the family needs it.
- Led by Brad Lamm, founder and lead interventionist (Certified Intervention Professional), and Shoaib Haroon, Chief Executive Officer.

## What Intervention.com is not

- Not affiliated with the INTERVENTION television show.
- Not funded by city, state, or national organizations.
- Not an emergency service. If you are experiencing a real emergency, call 911 or go to your nearest emergency room.

## Intervention services

- [Interventions overview](https://intervention.com/intervention): Intervention services by situation.
- [Drug or Alcohol Intervention Services](https://intervention.com/intervention/drug-alcohol-intervention): Guidance from a drug interventionist and programs designed for lasting recovery.
- [Eating Disorder Intervention Services](https://intervention.com/intervention/eating-disorder): Expert guidance, care, and hope for families of a loved one with an eating disorder.
- [Mental Health Crisis Intervention](https://intervention.com/intervention/mental-health-crisis): Support from a professional mental health interventionist for a loved one in crisis.
- [Complex Trauma Intervention](https://intervention.com/intervention/complex-trauma): A trauma intervention program to help loved ones heal from complex trauma.
- [Interventionists by State](https://intervention.com/interventionists-by-state): Find qualified interventionists by state.

## Additional services

- [Additional services overview](https://intervention.com/services): Services that support recovery beyond the intervention.
- [BreakFree Journey](https://intervention.com/breakfree-journey): A comprehensive, compassionate program to help families and individuals break the cycle of addiction.
- [BreakFree & Launch](https://intervention.com/breakfree-launch): A 21-day intensive for young adults.
- [BreakFree & Assess](https://intervention.com/breakfree-and-assess): A 360-degree assessment for a deeper understanding and a clearer path forward.
- [Coaching and Companion Services](https://intervention.com/recovery-coach-companion): Personalized recovery coaching and companionship through each step of recovery.
- [Recovery Care Management](https://intervention.com/recovery-care-management): Ongoing support and coordination for lasting sobriety and mental wellness.
- [Senior Support Services](https://intervention.com/senior-support-services): Addiction and mental health support tailored to older adults.
- [BreakFree Intervention Skills Training](https://intervention.com/trainings/breakfree-intervention-skills-training): Training in effective intervention techniques.
- [Family Class](https://intervention.com/family-class): Education and support for families.
